notes.title: Announcing our new project!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As mentioned on our previous post, we are already working hard on our next project, and now you can finally check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3495270/Hell_Under_Ice/

[b]Hell Under Ice[/b] is a more ambitious project, featuring [i]four player coop[/i], as well as [i]procedurally generated environments[/i] and overall [i]much more content[/i] than our previous release.

We want to make sure it releases in a polished state, and that it is fun to play. We will be sharing all further news and announcements on the Hell Under Ice store page, so [b][u]make sure to wishlist[/u][/b] in order to stay updated!

This is all for now. As always, thank you for the support.

[i]Regards,[/i]
[i]The Collarpill Team[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710980/09c2495da9e9681f443fc0a7b608c52bd561c7a6.png[/img]

notes.title: Thank you.
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

We're making this post to thank you. Thank you for the reviews, for buying the game, for playing and sharing your feedback, and for all the support.

It is surreal for us as a small indie team to have this much positivity on our first release. Here is a recap of everything that happened since we launched our title up until now:

[list]
[*] We sold over [b]1500[/b] copies;
[*] Reached [b]5000+[/b] wishlists;
[*] A "[b]Very Positive[/b]" rating with [b]98%[/b] of total reviews being positive;
[*] We got [u][b]Steam Deck verified[/b][/u]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710980/ccd845ca00aa7e9e028b0766e92b1141fd9ed4b6.png[/img]
[/list]
[i][b]And we're not done.[/b][/i]

We are already working hard on our next project, set on a completely different world with totally different gameplay mechanics. We can't wait to show you what we've been working on, but for the time being, here's a sneak peek:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710980/ce1ecee8910597535ef4f3892e885b12720faf60.gif[/img]

To close it all out, thank you once more. We'll still do some minor updates on [b]For Sale[/b] just to ensure the smoothest experience possible, but rest assured that most of our focus is now directed towards creating an amazing, original experience for you to enjoy.

[i]Talk to you soon,
The Collarpill Team.[/i]

notes.title: For Sale works great on the Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're happy to share that For Sale runs perfectly fine on the Steam Deck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710980/85807501a16dfa241f5e79f41698597ba14ae5af.jpg[/img]

The game runs at a stable 60 FPS if you're on the LCD model, and 90 FPS if you're on the OLED model. On some areas however, it does consume a lot of power, but it never dips below 60.

Controls are all mapped appropriately and prompts appear at key moments letting you know when needed. 

The only issue we've identified so far is that in the late game, the game might crash at a very specific point. To remedy that for the time being, we introduced a "Continue" option on the main menu, so you can pick up and play from close to where you were, that way you don't lose much progress. We believe we may have fixed this, but please let us know if you encounter this issue.

We hope you have a great experience playing For Sale on the go. If possible, leave us a review/feedback on how your experience goes when playing on the Deck!

notes.title: New title and new artwork!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710980/1bad2b0439ec65dd20d16af6508632ac8d5e9c3c.png[/img]

[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We want to share with you the changes we made to our project. The most important thing we had to do was change the title, as the previous title was trademarked (and with us being first time foreign developers, we weren't aware).

Thankfully, we settled for a new title/art all in less than 24 hours. Now, the game is titled [b]FOR SALE[/b]. 

We feel like this title fits the project nicely, and we're proud of what we managed to create in such a short amount of time prior to release.

This is the last day before the official release, and we couldn't be more excited. Thank you for the support, for sharing with your friends, wishlisting and we hope you purchase the game and enjoy it just as much as we enjoyed creating it.

Well, this is it! See you tomorrow.

[i]The house awaits you.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710980/58ea328a05b48d8ea589dd4a1570c49f7e07c08e.png[/img]

notes.title: Official Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

First of all, thank you to all who wishlisted so far! We're [i]almost at 1.000 wishlists[/i] (currently sitting at around 950) - your support means the world to us in this first release, so [i]make sure to share[/i] with any friends you know that would be interested in the game.

Second of all, we've done some slight tweaks and decided to officially release the project on the [b]17th of January, 2025[/b]. This is because we want to ensure maximum visibility of the project, and releasing in December wouldn't be the best option for us due to the Holidays and Steam sales.

That extra time also helps us to market the project further and also polish the game as a whole to ensure to you a solid, consistent experience from start to finish.

Having said all that, see you in a couple of weeks! We're really excited to show you what we've been up to all this time...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710980/2486409656be8e15bcc7678360c8f6e8a6f37a16.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement + Updates!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This is our first announcement ever, so first of all, we'd like to thank you for [b]almost a thousand wishlists[/b]!

To be clear with you, we're sitting at 860 at the moment. It would be amazing to hit 1.000+ before the release of [i]FOR SALE[/i], so if you're interested or know any friends that would be interested in the game, make sure to share it with them as that helps us tremendously!

Furthermore, we've updated our Steam Store page with [u]fresh screenshots + a new trailer[/u] with some more gameplay! In case you haven't seen it, you can find it on the FOR SALE store page or watch it here: 

[previewyoutube=rgsOzOJmKPQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]FOR SALE[/i] has been in the works for well over a year now, and it's our first project as a team. We've been carefully crafting everything to make sure we have a quality, consistent experience from start to finish.

As for a [b]release date[/b]... the Steam Store page is correct: [u]we aim to release FOR SALE by the end of this month.[/u] 

We really hope you enjoy the experience, and make sure to follow us on all socials in order to stay up to date on our future projects. We are just getting started!
